 Gigi Hadid made waves this week at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show , but it was her backstage beauty confession that has skincare fans buzzing.
 During a backstage interview, the 31-year-old model revealed one of her go-to skincare favorites: Dr. Melaxin's Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule , a TikTok Shop favorite she says works.
 The K-beauty treatment is designed to exfoliate dead skin cells, clear away impurities and blackheads , and leave skin looking brighter and smoother. Formulated with rice extract and niacinamide, the ampoule helps refine the look of pores while keeping skin hydrated and plump. It also features a blend of AHA, BHA and PHA exfoliants to help improve skin texture and reveal a more radiant complexion.
